body:
Referring to req # 2.2.5 (https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x11-V2-Authentication.md#v22-general-authenticator-requirements):
"Verify that where a Credential Service Provider (CSP) and the application verifying authentication are separated, mutually authenticated TLS is in place between the two endpoints."

How exactly would such a scenario look like?
What would be the task of the CSP if he doesn't verify the authentication?

Thanks in advance.

comments.body: I prefer to fully drop this requirement, its strange. Would you care to PR the removal of this requirement?

> I prefer to fully drop this requirement, its strange. Would you care to PR the removal of this requirement?

@jmanico Can you or an admin create a label such as "Create PR" so we can track those needing a PR?
We are mapping to the NIST standard and will be leaving this as is.
